record.title: Experimental infection of dogs with Babesia microti
record.journal: Obihiro University of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine Institutional Repository

screening.species: B. microti (experimental inoculation; confirmed by PCR and IFA)
screening.rationale: From the OpenAlex record and the repository PDF summary (Ohmori, Uetsuka and Nunoya, J Protozool Res 21:78-84, 2011): two dogs were inoculated experimentally and followed for parasitaemia, with a transient fall in red cell counts and no clinical signs. An experimental infection that reports host responses meets the criteria, and the review already holds B. microti in dogs (CB127).
